target.label: Make sides
target.desc: Block-compressed formats (DXT/BC, ETC, ASTC) need multiples of 4; mipmaps and older GPUs prefer powers of two.

n.label: Multiple of
n.desc: Every side becomes a multiple of this value.

allowNonSquare.label: Allow non-square POT
allowNonSquare.desc: Off: both sides become the larger power of two (square texture).

maxSize.label: Maximum size
maxSize.desc: Caps each side to the largest valid size not above this value. 0 = unlimited.

method.label: Method
method.desc: Resample scales the image, Pad adds canvas around it (never loses pixels), Crop cuts the edges (never adds pixels).

round.label: Rounding
round.desc: Direction to the nearest valid size. Only for Resample: Pad always rounds up and Crop always rounds down.

filter.label: Filter
filter.desc: Resampling filter; Nearest keeps pixel art crisp.

keepAspect.label: Keep aspect ratio
keepAspect.desc: Scales uniformly to fit inside the new size, then fills the rest with the pad color.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.desc: Where the original content sits in the new canvas (or which part is kept when cropping).

padColor.label: Pad color
padColor.desc: Color of the added area. Fully transparent by default.
